concept: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: design-only character concept and five-dance visual board for a Naruto survivor game, NOT a production sprite atlas. Create an attractive wide landscape concept sheet with restrained dark slate background and six clearly separated panels, numbered only 01 to 06, no other text. Reference image is our original Gaara atlas STYLE AND PROPORTION ONLY: match compact approximately 3-head-tall proportions, dark thin outlines, sharp flat clusters, limited two-tone shading, readable at small size; DO NOT draw Gaara or gourd. Subject is young KIMIMARO: very pale skin, green eyes, straight center-parted light silver hair reaching shoulders with two longer side locks, two red forehead dots, loose pale gray open V-neck elbow-length kimono top, purple rope belt with bow behind, dark cropped trousers and navy open-toed sandals. All panels same character design and scale. 01 neutral normal full-body front three-quarter pose and small back view showing rope bow; arm-held slim ivory bone sword. 02 Willow dance: graceful low lateral step with forearm bones and one flowing cross-cut; compact faint ivory slash arc. 03 Camellia dance: assertive forward bone-sword thrust sequence shown as three clear successive poses left to right. 04 Larch dance: low braced body, recognizable ivory ribs/bone spikes protrude from torso, shoulder and forearms in all directions, very short local circular sweep. 05 Clematis dance: two sequential poses: long articulated vertebral whip uncoils from hand, then huge spiraling layered ivory bone drill surrounds the other forearm pointing right. No gore, no blood. 06 Bracken dance: small Kimimaro kneeling with one hand planted on ground, wide isometric ground ellipse with many large ivory bone spikes erupting progressively across it and tiny gray enemy silhouettes at three separated locations; bone forest with open readable gaps, no water or sand. Strong deliberate distinct action silhouettes, clean game-concept presentation with margin. All anatomy clean, ivory bone material with lavender shadows, no golden armor, no glowing magic circles, no photorealism, no UI, no health bars, no logos, no random writing. Draw newly original artwork based on character, never copy commercial sprite poses.
transformation: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: companion transformation and storyboard concept board for young KIMIMARO in our Naruto survivor game. Reference image1 is our newly drawn five-dance concept: SAME normal character identity, hairstyle, costume, proportions, bone color and polished flat-shaded small game character illustration style. Wide landscape, dark slate panels, crisp outlines, no blur. Upper row 4 equal sequential fullbody poses numbered 01 02 03 04 ONLY: 01 normal pale-skin Kimimaro with silver center-part hair, green eyes, two red forehead dots, light gray open-neck shirt, purple rope bow belt, dark pants, navy sandals; 02 same body crouches with black curse marks spreading across exposed skin only, shirt unchanged; 03 anatomically transformed CURSE SEAL LEVEL TWO Kimimaro, gray-brown skin, black eye surrounds, silver hair kept, upper body bare, dark cropped pants with purple rope belt, strong ivory bone spikes symmetrically protrude from back, long segmented gray-brown TAIL curling behind, lower heavy posture, not horns or wings; 04 same cursed level2 fully ready side three-quarter with back spikes and long tail clearly visible, giant layered spiral ivory bone spear wrapped around one forearm pointing to right. Keep approximately 3-head-tall game-character proportions and same body scale, no giant monster or tall realistic man. Lower row: 4 equal clean action storyboard panels, use small numbers 05 06 07 08 ONLY. 05 cursed Kimimaro crouches hand to earth; below ground a readable faint ground ellipse contains three separated gray enemy silhouettes; 06 bone spike tips emerge in INNER ring of ellipse, outer remains clear; 07 ivory forest expands into MIDDLE ring with many sharpened columns, keep three gray enemies readable; 08 bone forest reaches OUTER ellipse edge, same fixed environment and same camera, cursed Kimimaro still at center visible between spires, broad dark gaps between ivory spikes, demonstrate genuine area coverage. Ivory bone purple-gray shadows, ground cracks restrained, no blood no gore. This is static design storyboard, not a production sprite atlas. No full text, no legends, no photorealism, no fire, no aura, no glowing circle, no water or sand effects, no copied commercial artwork.
